Resolves #19893

The dock's rail-click reveal test leaves quarantine. Its signal bracket counted any `dock-animating` element. The auto-hide setup's own projection motion can still be signalled when the witness arms, so the bracket opened and closed on that motion, the witness stopped before the overlay painted, and it read 0 samples although the reveal ran. The test now settles the setup's signal first and brackets only the overlay's own signal (`RevealOverlay#beginRevealMotion` → `MotionSignal.enter(this)`). A failing read names its gap count. Test-only; no product code changes.

Evidence: L2 (the diagnosis rests on hosted run logs and code: red attempts ~0.4 s shorter, bracket passing while samples read 0) → L3 required (AC-2: every attempt green across ≥ 5 hosted runs of this PR). Residual: AC-2, Residual-Owner: this PR (re-runs before review).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `DockMotionNL.spec.mjs`: `expectSignalBracket` takes `selector`; the SLIDES test polls `SIGNAL` to 0 after the setup, then brackets `.neo-dashboard-dock-reveal-overlay.neo-dashboard-dock-animating` |
| AC-2 | `e2eCiSelection.mjs`: the entry is removed; hosted runs of this PR count once green (re-runs recorded in a PR comment) |
| AC-3 | The samples assertion's message includes `gaps` |
